reviewNotes: Twelve Codex AI candidates for the four existing update-description languages only. Public network rainfall sample, not farm measurements or crop advice. Reported quantities, missing values and source times remain distinct. No fluent or human approval and no new runtime language. Separate from native AGY draft ownership.

releasePairs.english: Check an Environment Agency rainfall reference
releasePairs.st: Hlahloba tshupiso ya pula ya Environment Agency
releasePairs.ve: Sedzulusani referentsi ya mvula ya Environment Agency
releasePairs.ts: Kambela rheferense ya mpfula ya Environment Agency

releasePairs.english: Country evidence → United Kingdom → Public rainfall network sample
releasePairs.zu: Ubufakazi bezwe → United Kingdom → Isibonelo senethiwekhi yomphakathi yemvula
releasePairs.st: Bopaki ba naha → United Kingdom → Mohlala wa marangrang a sechaba a pula

releasePairs.ts: Vumbhoni bya tiko → United Kingdom → Nkombiso wa netiweke ya mpfula ya mani na mani

releasePairs.english: Request one public network example with reported rainfall, missing values and source times kept distinct. This reference does not measure your farm or change crop advice.
releasePairs.zu: Cela isibonelo esisodwa senethiwekhi yomphakathi, lapho imvula ebikiwe, amanani angekho nezikhathi zomthombo kugcinwa ngokwehlukana. Le referensi ayikali imvula epulazini lakho noma ishintshe izeluleko zezitshalo.
releasePairs.st: Kopa mohlala o le mong wa marangrang a sechaba moo pula e tlalehilweng, dipalo tse siyo le dinako tsa mohlodi di bolokwang di arohane. Tshupiso ena ha e lekanye pula polasing ya hao kapa ho fetola keletso ya dijalo.
releasePairs.ve: Humbelani tsumbo nthihi ya nethiweke ya nnyi na nnyi, hune mvula yo vhigwaho, mivhalo i siho na zwifhinga zwa tshiko zwa dzula zwo fhambanywa. Iyi referentsi a i kali mvula kha bulasi ḽaṋu kana u shandula nyeletshedzo ya zwimela.
releasePairs.ts: Kombela nkombiso wun’we wa netiweke ya mani na mani laha mpfula leyi vikiweke, mimpimo leyi nga riki kona ni minkarhi ya xihlovo swi hlayisiwaka swi hambanile. Rheferense leyi a yi pimi mpfula epurasini ra wena kumbe ku cinca switsundzuxo swa swibyariwa.
